interventions: Deterministic order: actual baseline, all-mapped control, singleton indices 0..895, then 28 contiguous ascending 32-coordinate shards each immediately followed by its 864-coordinate complement. Each control starts from the same authenticated actual L12 parent, copying all I/Z/H fields together at precisely the selected coordinates. Complement means all coordinates outside that shard are mapped; it is not a separately propagated or relifted parent.
mapping: Reuse the reviewed exact rational nearest-Q24 ties-even mapping of the independently propagated original-input L12 binary64 vector; preserve negative zero and derive H by independent exact RNE16 projection. Assert bitwise equality to the reviewed mapped parent and a per-coordinate mapping error <= 2^-25. This counterfactual never replaces the original-input L13 global reference.

thresholds.S0_S17: Unchanged finite AND (absolute_error <= 0.125 OR (relative_error < 0.001 AND ordered_FP16_ULP <= 1)); denominator max(abs(reference), 2^-14); independent same-actual-operand local references.
thresholds.S18: Unchanged binary64-fp16-excess-v1: exact actual error minus nearest-FP16 representation floor <= 1/8, against the original-input independently propagated global reference.
thresholds.FP16_trajectory: Unchanged diagnostic-only comparisons under the existing v3 policy.

gates: Every one of the 954 controls executes all 19 native L13 stages and all unchanged mandatory gates, with exact paired-state, actual-operand, native S16 RTZ and own-layer empty P0 KV checks. Numerical failures are retained, not bypassed; invalid lineage/source/state/operands or missing checks block. Scalar rescue and all-L13-gates-pass are reported separately; no counterfactual is admitted or published.
classification: Any accepted singleton is conditional single-coordinate sufficiency; absent that, an accepted shard or complement is bounded shard sufficiency; absent both, the reproduced full-parent rescue leaves subset interactions unresolved. Record all accepted output words, including words other than 662f. Never infer a unique upstream producer or exhaustive interaction attribution from these controls.
claim_boundary: CPU-software coordinate diagnostic only. Q24 residual state is wider than FP16; native G128 asymmetric INT4 AWQ weights/nibble order/no qzero plus-one, FP16 scales/operators/KV and S16 RTZ are unchanged. Historical failures and bounded Reviewer acceptance remain intact. No strict-FP16-state W4A16, new-token, full-model, RTL, simulation, synthesis, GPU, FPGA, hardware, PPA, performance-bottleneck or unique-producer claim. No policy adoption, successor publication or follow-on task selection.
execution_boundary: --check compiles the repository sources and runs only the v3 and v2 focused suites, then authenticates retained/current bindings without native dispatch. --execute additionally runs exactly the 954 isolated L13/P0 controls into a fresh v3 build directory; never replay the accepted prefix or admission run. This delivery task does not execute those controls. Future execution and its non-admission evidence require a separate bounded task and normal Host review.
reproduction: Run command once from cwd with the explicit absolute interpreter and command-local PYTHONPATH. No files are written by --check. The execution command is a template: replace only the fresh output basename, never reuse an existing path, and use the operator-required durable runner for the long execution. Independent Reviewer must reproduce the check with zero failures/errors/skips. No historical bare-Python command is certified.
authentication: Inherit the hash-pinned v2 check contract and its exact retained/current source-update closure. Bind all reviewed artifacts and original snapshots without relabeling current sources as historical execution. Consume the authenticated retained operand/state/KV evidence read-only; recheck the L12 receipt, paired state, own-layer KV, RTZ operands and original-input reference chain before dispatch. Every control uses the unchanged native L13 stage/gate implementation. Reproduce both reviewed endpoints and recheck all bindings and origins at completion.
